assets.purpose: Hard-motion centerpiece of the 20–25-second POC; prove group carry, body continuity, smoke, environment and watercolour style.
assets.source_or_case: Verified project case: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance; see sources.md. Re-created scene, not archival footage or a representation of a named participant.
assets.visual_subject: A community team carries an incense dragon through a narrow Hong Kong street; individual bearers are visible as moving people, not a single animated silhouette.
assets.primary_action: The team takes coordinated weight-bearing steps around the corner; dragon body follows, smoke trails and street depth changes continuously.
assets.camera: Moving lateral three-quarter track that completes the turn in one uninterrupted 9-second action; shoulder-height camera, practical distance.
assets.sound: Layer spatial footsteps, cloth/dragon movement, ember crackle and street voices; synchronize the corner-step and tail movement. Prefer legally usable recorded/source Foley.
assets.music_relation: Begin with a sparse low wood pulse; let real steps create rhythm. Add no beat that masks the footfall; hand off to kitchen room tone on the cut.

assets.prompt: Hand-painted watercolor and live ink-line texture, wet pigment edges but stable anatomy. A small Tai Hang community team bears a long incense fire dragon around one narrow street corner, synchronized steps transfer visible weight from foot to foot; the dragon follows the turn with believable mass, ember points and smoke drift with the street air. Shoulder-height lateral tracking, one continuous action, warm neighborhood practical light; no parade symmetry, no frozen carriers, no morphing limbs, no text, no slow-motion fantasy.
assets.first_frame_requirement: First frame begins mid-preparation with bearers and dragon already physically connected; smoke and bodies are in the same light and street depth.
assets.last_frame_requirement: Dragon tail completes the turn after the lead bearers; feet settle into the next stride before the edit to the family interior.
assets.continuity_requirement: Bearer count, clothing palette, dragon scale, grip/contact, turn direction and paper-watercolor stroke remain stable throughout the action.
acceptance_criteria: believable contact, load and coordinated steps
watercolour ink texture stays coherent in motion
steps/dragon movement have useful sync points
